0.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000
0.description: I'm quite busy at the moment, so unless you have something to ask...

5.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_010
5.description: I am Redolent Rose, and I oversee all Weavers' Guild operations. I also instruct members on the finer points of our trade─something I am quite good at, mind you.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_011
6.description: My most skilled protégés go on to create magnificent garments which are coveted the realm over.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_012
7.description: Indeed, it would be no exaggeration to say that the designs born here shape Eorzean fashion.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_013
8.description: It matters not how great or small the commission─we never fail to deliver the highest quality to the customer.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_020
9.description: Simply put, a weaver transforms thread into cloth and cloth into clothing.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_021
10.description: More specifically, weavers craft light, flowing garments such as robes and coatees─the kind favored by mages and craftsmen.

11.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_022
11.description: While a novice weaver should focus on producing serviceable wares, we expect our more experienced members to blend form with function.

12.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_023
12.description: But regardless of one's experience, a weaver must ever strive to hone his craft if he wishes to achieve <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> maintain success.

15.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_041
15.description: ...Mayhap you wonder why I do not call for the Brass Blades? Please. Your virtue is more intact than that of a maiden at the altar. So─what brings you here today?

16.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_050
16.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I take it you have found a commission in Ishgard? I'm a bit envious, in truth. Pray do bring me tidings of the lords and ladies in their finery.

17.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_060
17.description: Ever since hearing your tales of the Holy See, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, my dreams are filled with scenes of nobles riding to war in their splendor.

18.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_061
18.description: So I have vowed that someday I will see Ishgard. Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, but someday.

19.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_070
19.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You'll be pleased to hear that our new partnership with Daitenya is already bearing fruit.

20.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_071
20.description: The Ul'dahn elite have taken quite a liking to the exotic fashions of the Far East, and it is surely but a matter of time until our creations find a similarly receptive audience overseas.

21.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_080
21.description: Welcome home, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I hear that you made quite a name for yourself over in the Far East.

22.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_081
22.description: Mind you, there won't be any time to rest on your laurels. Why, commissions for Hingan fashions are pouring in by the day, and they're not going to weave themselves.

23.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_090
23.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I've heard much of your exploits in all corners of the world!

24.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_091
24.description: <hex:021A020203>How<hex:021A020103> did I hear, you ask? Why, one in my position must stay on top of all the latest trends and fashions, yes? My little birds were keen to share tales of your deeds, as well!

29.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_100
29.description: Wawarukka and Kokomo's courtship continues, but I cannot say how long it will last. They were not particularly well acquainted prior to our intervention, in case you have forgotten.

30.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_101
30.description: I do not mean to diminish our accomplishment, but the first expression of affection is but a single step in a never-ending journey.

31.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_102
31.description: As they learn more of one another, they may grow closer together or further apart. Which is fine. They will be richer for the experience, regardless of the outcome.

32.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_120
32.description: Believe it or not, I received a letter not a few days past from Averil, of all people! By some small miracle, both she and her lover came back safe from the front lines of battle. In fact, Averil has taken to studying conjury from her mother!

33.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_121
33.description: All's well that ends well, I suppose.

34.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_130
34.description: Our partnership with Daitenya grows more profitable by the day, and it would seem we have you and this Kotocho girl to thank. Yes, Master Keimei tells me that Eorzean fashions are all the rage in Kugane these days.

35.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_131
35.description: Do you hear that sound, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? That's the sound of gil pouring into our coffers. Keep up the <hex:021A020203>smashing<hex:021A020103> work!

36.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_140
36.description: You'll be happy to know I've received some letters from some of your adoring fans out there! They've asked me to share with you their own recent exploits.

37.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_141
37.description: I'm overjoyed to report that Wawarukka and Kokomo are at long last getting married! Doesn't it warm the cockles of your heart to see a young couple united by a love of good fashion?

38.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_142
38.description: And do you remember Averil from Ishgard? She's been putting the magicks she learned from her mother to good use, making quite the name for herself in Garlemald alongside her beloved.

39.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_000_143
39.description: And across the sea in Kugane, the dancer Kotocho is earning one rave review after the next─and orders for the latest in Western fashions are pouring in from Master Keimei. For all of this, we've you to thank, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Why don't you take a bow?

40.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_110
40.description: If you so dearly wish to play the part of a neophyte, I suppose I can indulge you this once. Do not make it a habit.

41.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_111
41.description: Simply put, a weaver transforms thread into cloth and cloth into clothing.

42.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_112
42.description: More specifically, weavers craft light, flowing garments such as robes and coatees─the kind favored by mages and craftsmen.

43.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_113
43.description: While a novice weaver should focus on producing serviceable wares, we expect our more experienced members to blend form with function.

44.name: TEXT_REGWILWVRGUILD_00066_REDOLENTROSE_114
44.description: But regardless of one's experience, a weaver must ever strive to hone his craft if he wishes to achieve <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> maintain success.<hex:02100103>...Thus ends our charade.
